---
title: "Gallery"
lightbox: auto
---

```{r}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(fs)

img_files <- fs::dir_ls("galleryImages", ignore.case = TRUE)

captionsAll <- read.csv("galleryImageCaptions.csv")

# 3. Open a Quarto CSS Grid Container}
cat("::: {layout-ncol=3}\n\n")


# 4. Loop through images to output them with their captions
for (img in img_files) {
  
  # Generate a clean caption from the filename (e.g., "sunset-over-mountains.jpg" -> "Sunset Over Mountains")
  raw_name <- fs::path_file(img)
 
  #caption  <- stringr::str_to_title(gsub("[-_]", " ", raw_name))
  caption <- toString(captionsAll[captionsAll$file == raw_name,][,3])
   #print(caption)

  # Format as a Quarto lightbox image with an automatic caption
  # Syntax: ![Caption](path){.lightbox group="gallery"}
  cat(sprintf('![%s](%s){.lightbox group="lightroom-gallery"}\n\n', caption, img))
}

# 5. Close the layout block
cat(":::\n")
```
